briefs.text: Shenzhou-24 crew named; launch Wed 07:18 WIB.
VW pay talks open; 22 plants, ~39,000 strike.
Gas blast at hotpot eatery kills 6.
M5.3 quake on Nepal–India border; no casualties.
5 women killed an hour by partners or family.
DR Congo rebels say advance halted.
Donald 85 off 32; England win by 8 wickets.
Czechia sweep Canada 2–0 in Davis Cup.
Madrid 5–1 PSV; City 2–2 Napoli; Arsenal 1–1 Dortmund.
NATO sends AWACS plane to Poland.
Iran says a 4th tanker hit a mine.
